evidence_observations: Direct mining executes template -> localPow -> submit-block without a concurrent tip-invalidating cancellation path.
The global refresh loop polls every 7000 ms but does not cancel an in-flight Proof-of-Work Worker when height or tip_hash changes.
The backend /status response already exposes authoritative height and tip_hash.
The backend rejects a solved block with stale_tip when submitted height or previous_hash no longer matches the current chain tip.
Template policy is snapshot: mempool changes after template creation do not by themselves invalidate Proof of Work.
invariants: The network tip identified by authoritative FAE network state remains the source of truth.
BroadcastChannel or any same-device mechanism may only accelerate revalidation; it never becomes chain authority.
A template remains valid across mempool-only changes under snapshot semantics.
A change in template height or previous_hash caused by chain-tip advancement invalidates the prior Proof-of-Work session.
The user must not need Stop -> Start merely because the chain advanced.
Old Worker callbacks/results cannot mutate or complete a newer mining session.
Cancellation must not create false-positive discards of work that is still tip-valid.
Direct and coordinator/share paths must preserve their existing reward-address and verification boundaries.
No consensus, supply, reward, halving or target-block-time parameter is changed by this Lab.
All required failures remain evidence; retries cannot erase a failed run.

acceptance_metrics.tip_identity: height + tip_hash on network state; work identity binds template height + previous_hash
acceptance_metrics.foreground_local_reaction: p95 <= 250 ms from authoritative mismatch observation to old Worker termination
acceptance_metrics.foreground_loaded_reaction: p99 <= 1000 ms from authoritative mismatch observation to old Worker termination under synthetic client load
acceptance_metrics.post_observation_stale_progress: zero accepted progress/result events from the invalidated Worker generation
acceptance_metrics.resume_safety: after background/suspension, authoritative tip revalidation occurs before resumed stale work may be accepted or submitted
acceptance_metrics.false_positive_rule: mempool-only changes and unchanged height+tip_hash must not cancel valid snapshot work
acceptance_metrics.correctness_rule: multi-context correctness must pass without BroadcastChannel enabled
